claude.name: claude
claude.description: Create a sandboxed box and launch Claude Code in a detachable tmux session

arguments.name: claude-args
arguments.description: extra args passed to claude inside the box; place after `--`, e.g. `agentbox claude -- --model sonnet`

options.description: host workspace to mount
friendly box name (default: <workspace-basename>-<id>)
APFS-clone the host workspace into a per-box scratch dir before seeding /workspace (stabilizes the tar-pipe source)
tar-pipe directly from the live host workspace at create time
start from a project checkpoint (see `agentbox checkpoint`); overrides box.defaultCheckpoint
override the box image
skip prompts, accept defaults
auto-approve agentbox.yaml's `carry:` block (also AGENTBOX_CARRY_YES=1). Required for non-TTY use of `-y` when carry: is non-empty.
control the carry: block; 'skip' disables it for this box (also AGENTBOX_CARRY=skip). Default: 'ask' (prompt).

copy a git credential INTO the box so it can push with your PC off. You'll be asked at an interactive prompt to choose 'token' (HTTPS, unsigned commits, smallest exposure) or your 'ssh' private key (signs commits, riskiest). DANGEROUS: the credential lives in the box and its snapshots. Requires a real terminal (no non-interactive / CI path). Cloud only. Sets git.pushMode=direct.
use a per-box ~/.claude volume instead of the shared agentbox-claude-config
also install @playwright/cli@latest globally inside the box
launch claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions (auto-accept tool use); on by default since boxes are isolated
do not pass --dangerously-skip-permissions to claude in this box
copy host env/config files (.env*, secrets.toml, agentbox.yaml, ...) into /workspace at create time (gitignore-bypassing)
disable the per-box Xvnc + noVNC web client (on by default)
do not sync the box with the host on start (default: merge the host's current branch + overlay its uncommitted/untracked changes, keeping the box's version on conflict)
use the shared 'agentbox-docker-cache' volume for in-box docker images (preserved on destroy; only one box can run at a time when set)
map the box web app to https://<name>.localhost via the Portless proxy (Docker Desktop)
do not register a Portless alias for this box
tmux session name (default from config; built-in: claude)
memory ceiling (e.g. 512m, 2g); unset = unlimited
CPU count cap (fractional ok, e.g. 1.5); unset = unlimited
max process count (PIDs cgroup); unset = unlimited
best-effort writable-layer size (e.g. 10g); no-op on overlay2/macOS
sandbox backend: 'docker' (default) or 'daytona' for a cloud box
base the box's per-box branch on this ref (branch / tag / SHA) instead of HEAD. Branch/tag names are fetched from origin first.

reuse an existing branch directly instead of forking agentbox/<box-name>. Commits/pushes flow straight to it. Docker fails if the host already has it checked out. Mutually exclusive with --from-branch.
force building this cloud box on the control box (then adopt + attach here). When a control box is configured this is already the default for foreground cloud runs (cloud.viaHub). Ignored for docker.
force building the box on this machine even when a control box is configured (the opposite of --via-hub).
control-box URL for the hub route (default: relay.controlPlaneUrl)
bypass the spinner and stream raw provider output (docker build / Daytona snapshot create) to stderr. The same content always lands in ~/.agentbox/logs/claude.log.

where to open the attached session: split | window | tab | same (default from attach.openIn, built-in: split). Only effective when running inside tmux or iTerm2; falls back to inline attach otherwise.

attach inline in the current terminal (shortcut for --attach-in same; useful when attach.openIn defaults to split/window/tab). The short `-i` form was reassigned to `--initial-prompt` on the create-style commands (claude/codex/opencode).
create the box and start the agent session, but do not attach (background mode); prints the box ref and exits 0. Re-attach later with `agentbox <agent> attach <box>`.

seed the claude session with this initial user turn and run in background (no attach). Jobs go through the host-wide queue (queue.maxConcurrent). NOTE: this is NOT claude's own `-p` headless print mode — for that, pass `-- -p ...`.
per-invocation override of queue.maxConcurrent; only honored when `-i` is set
per-invocation override of queue.maxWorking; only honored when `-i` is set
teleport the most recent host Claude Code session for this cwd into the box and resume from it
teleport the specified host Claude Code session id into the box and resume from it
copy a Claude Code plan file (e.g. ~/.claude/plans/<slug>.md) into the box, launch claude with --permission-mode plan, and seed a "resume the plan" prompt

subcommands.description: Attach to a Claude Code tmux session in a box, starting one if none is running (auto-unpause/start; never re-syncs ~/.claude — use `claude start` for that)

options.description: tmux session name (default from config; built-in: claude)

where to open the attached session: split | window | tab | same (default from attach.openIn, built-in: split). Only effective when running inside tmux or iTerm2; falls back to inline attach otherwise.

attach inline in the current terminal (shortcut for --attach-in same; useful when attach.openIn defaults to split/window/tab). The short `-i` form was reassigned to `--initial-prompt` on the create-style commands (claude/codex/opencode).

subcommands.name: start
subcommands.description: Start a Claude Code tmux session in an already-existing box (auto-unpause/start). If a session is already running, just attach.

arguments.name: box
arguments.description: box ref: project index, id, id prefix, name, or container (default: the only box in this project)

arguments.name: claude-args
arguments.description: extra args passed to claude when starting a new session; ignored if a session is already running. Place after `--`, e.g. `agentbox claude start 1 -- --model sonnet`

options.description: tmux session name (default from config; built-in: claude)
skip rsyncing the host's ~/.claude into the box's volume before starting (faster; use existing in-box state)

where to open the attached session: split | window | tab | same (default from attach.openIn, built-in: split). Only effective when running inside tmux or iTerm2; falls back to inline attach otherwise.

attach inline in the current terminal (shortcut for --attach-in same; useful when attach.openIn defaults to split/window/tab). The short `-i` form was reassigned to `--initial-prompt` on the create-style commands (claude/codex/opencode).
create the box and start the agent session, but do not attach (background mode); prints the box ref and exits 0. Re-attach later with `agentbox <agent> attach <box>`.
teleport the most recent host Claude Code session for this cwd into the box and resume
teleport the specified host Claude Code session id into the box and resume

subcommands.name: login
subcommands.description: Sign in to Claude for use in sandboxes (forwards args to `claude auth login`, e.g. --sso, --console). Runs in a throwaway container against the shared claude-config volume — usable before the first `agentbox claude`. In a terminal it prints the auth URL and prompts for the code. Non-interactive (no TTY) or `--headless`: prints the auth URL, then finish with `--code <CODE>`.

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: extra args forwarded to `claude auth login`; place after `--`, e.g. `agentbox claude login -- --sso`

options.description: drive login without a terminal: print the auth URL, then finish with `--code` (auto-selected when stdin is not a TTY)
deliver the OAuth code to a pending headless login session
attach your terminal to claude's own login TUI (legacy passthrough; try this if the guided prompt can't drive your login method)
